title: WNBA PRA Speed V3 Step 8 — Visible PRA content first
scope: Render a temporary Player identity + projected PRA shell from the already-selected Game Center snapshot before the frozen Step-7 Player loader begins, then remove it and render the frozen final Player surface unchanged.
root_cause: The frozen Player renderer invokes load_player_intelligence before its first visible Player hero/metric render, so loader latency blocks all visible Player content.

contract.game_card_continuity_source: already-visible frozen Game Center player card

permanent_guards.rule: exact client-preview PRODUCT repair scope is permanently isolated

evidence: Step-8 exact verifier scope guard passed on PR #1292.
The focused contract failed only in test_step8_establishes_cached_cold_precondition_before_timing_permanently.
The assertion compared the precompute call against the first started = time.monotonic() anywhere in the module instead of the speed timer inside run().
No production/verifier behavior failed before this test assertion.
branch_failure.root_cause: The permanent test used a module-global string index for the timer ordering assertion, so an earlier helper timer was mistaken for the Player speed timer.
branch_failure.patch: Scope the ordering assertion to the source text inside def run and compare the precompute-ready call against that run-local speed timer.

exact verifier-repair scope is permanently accepted and isolated

evidence: The merged-main proof observed the frozen Step-7 marker and exact-player Game Center continuity at 0.019 seconds, inside the unchanged 0.750-second target.
The final Player then took 2.748 seconds and tripped the unchanged 1.50-second cached-cold guard.
The verifier used only a fixed 1.25-second settle delay and never proved Step-7 background precompute completion before starting the cached-cold timer.
Step-7 exposes target/completed/running/errors on its frozen marker specifically to prove precompute readiness.
production_failure.root_cause: The verifier labeled the Player open cached-cold without establishing that the frozen Step-7 background precompute had completed.
production_failure.patch: Wait before the speed timer until the frozen Step-7 marker reports target>0, completed>=target, running=0, errors=0; then keep the exact 0.750s first-visible and 1.50s final-player thresholds unchanged.

production_failure_history.patch: Arm a browser MutationObserver before the Player click and timestamp matching addedNodes, preserving the exact 0.750-second target while reliably observing short-lived DOM insertion.
